display.purpose: Home page question and page headings.

data.purpose: WCAG criterion numbers, URLs, selectors, counts, dates and status labels only.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Hover fills and the mobile drawer slide (240ms).

motion.name: running-pulse
motion.purpose: The square marker on a RUNNING status tag; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action on a screen: Scan, Log in, Sign up.
components.css: .ds-btn { font: 700 1rem 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid #1747c8; border-radius: 2px; background: #1747c8; color: #fff; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #fff; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1747c8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: URL Field
components.description: Text and URL inputs; on the home page it joins the Scan button.
components.css: .ds-input { font: 400 1rem 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; min-height: 44px; padding: 9px 12px; border: 1px solid #767c86; border-radius: 2px; background: #fff; color: #16181d; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1747c8; outline-offset: 0; border-color: #1747c8; }

components.name: Impact Tag
components.description: Violation impact: tinted label plus a shape marker so color is never the only cue.
components.css: .ds-impact { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 2px; background: #fdecea; color: #b42318; font: 700 0.8rem 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', sans-serif; } .ds-impact i { width: 9px; height: 9px; background: currentColor; clip-path: polygon(50% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%); }

components.name: Sidebar Link
components.description: Navigation in the ink rail; active state is a fill plus bold weight.
components.html: New scanHow it works
components.css: .ds-rail { background: #16181d; padding: 12px; width: 240px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-rail a { color: #f2f3f5; text-decoration: none; padding: 9px 10px; border-radius: 2px; font: 500 0.95rem 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', sans-serif; } .ds-rail a:hover { background: #22252b; } .ds-rail a.is-active { background: #2e323a; font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview: Allyscan reads like the standard it enforces: an ink sidebar, a paper work area, hairline rules, square corners and one signal blue. Findings are indexed by WCAG success-criterion number, the way the specification itself is organized.
keyCharacteristics: Hairline rules instead of shadows and cards
WCAG criterion index on every report

rules.name: Pass your own scan
rules.body: Every page passes axe-core WCAG 2.0/2.1 A and AA plus best-practice rules, in both themes, at desktop and phone widths.

rules.name: No gradients
rules.body: No gradient text, radial glows or gradient fills anywhere.

dos: Pair status colors with labels or shapes
donts: Don't add kicker labels above headings
Don't add colored side stripes to boxes
